description: Operate the durable task queue: place tasks, fire events to wake them. No timers exist — deferred continuation is always an event. State machine ready→running→wait_human/wait_event→done. Actions: create_batch (ordered list of {title, body}; first item is delivered at once), status, skip (complete current head, start next), emit (fire a named event that waiting tasks subscribed to via wait_event), cancel, fanout (N competing branch proposals + a final JOIN digest row; near-duplicate annotate (attach a branch's verdict for the join), add_question / drop_question (open-question register: a task with open questions cannot be ack-closed), set_check (bind a machine validity command: at every delivery the kernel runs it and a non-zero exit converts the wake-up into a rework order instead of a reportable result).

chat_id.description: Messaging chat bound to the queue.

criteria.description: fanout: decision criteria surfaced in the join digest.

goal.description: fanout: the research goal the branches compete on.

question.description: add_question: open assumption; drop_question: exact text or 1-based number.
